Other transcripts that mention 'Judge for a Day' and are not in this batch: 09dddba098, 3f112e5df7, 6aa8d7ae63, be032f3167, d89547e51a. These may be clips or later re-airings of the serial (story_key judge-for-a-day). Pass 2 should link them.

The water/negel vasser talk in 376 (23e24d9359, about 927-1130 s) matches the Inyonei Mitzvos clip 'Netilas Yodayim 122' (f760feafed, the worked example, which already lists 376 as aired_again_in). Its id was not in this batch's facts, so I added no relation from 376.
The 'Judge for a Day' serial ends by revealing that Label grew up to be the Shaagas Aryeh. I proposed a people term (shaagas_aryeh) in 35d1a78d02.

Episodes 381 and 382 start at 'and shalom to everyone'; the first words of the greeting are probably clipped. The timestamps for the march segments in 381, 382 and 383 are estimates, because the march is untranscribed.
Episodes 375-378 were broadcast during Sefirah and have no theme or march, as stated on air.
In 382 the only private person named is an adult teacher. I used the privacy flag identifiable_living_people because the validator requires a flag.
